# The smallest window any GUI scale gives (a 640x480 window at GUI scale 2 = 320x240), with the made-up songs:
# - the song library's tabs in Spanish and European Portuguese end before the Grid, Shelf and Carousel buttons
#   ("Canciones favoritas", "Favoritas"; the Playlists tab whole, not under the buttons);
# - the message after a click on a song, "These songs are made up, so nothing plays", on two lines in Spanish and
#   Russian instead of ending in "…";
# - last, the "SkyLyrics can't read your music player" pop-up in Ukrainian, inside the screen with its left end and
#   first letters showing. It comes once per game, about 10 s after reading the music player starts failing, so it
#   shows only if the runner can't read music players (no D-Bus session); otherwise there is no pop-up to see.
# Run it: gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=<branch> -f size=640x480 -f script=.github/checks/fit-fixes.txt

cmd time set noon
look 0 -20
sleep 6
guiscale 2
set demoMode true
set libraryView GRID

lang es_es
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot fit-library-tabs-es
key right
sleep 0.5
key enter
sleep 1
shot fit-library-message-es
key tab
sleep 3
shot fit-library-playlists-es
# back to the liked songs (Tab goes on to Search, then Liked songs), where the library opens next time
key tab
sleep 0.5
key tab
sleep 1
close

lang pt_pt
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
shot fit-library-tabs-pt
close

lang ru_ru
sleep 15
screen dev.beli.skylyrics.gui.LibraryScreen
sleep 4
key right
sleep 0.5
key enter
sleep 1
shot fit-library-message-ru
close
